# Kudozz Club

> Kudozz Club is an India-focused travel agency that plans customized trips and tour packages across India. Travellers share where they want to go, their dates, budget and travel style through the Plan My Trip form; the Kudozz Club team plans the itinerary in-house and refines it with them by email. Pricing is quoted per enquiry; no fixed package prices are published. The agency is backed by a free library of 1,000+ India travel guides, including 580+ destination guides covering all 28 states and 8 union territories, which supply the destination knowledge behind every itinerary.

- Official website: https://club.kudozz.in (people also search for it as "Kudoz Club" or "Kudos Club")
- What it is: a travel agency (customized India trips and tour packages) that also publishes travel guides
- Where: India only, all 36 states and union territories
- How to start: the Plan My Trip form at https://club.kudozz.in/plan-your-trip, or email connect@kudozz.in
- Official social profile: https://www.instagram.com/kudozz.in/
- Not published (unconfirmed, so not stated anywhere on the site): office address, phone number, founding team, customer numbers, ratings, awards or registrations

This is the short guide to the site. The complete catalogue of every guide is at https://club.kudozz.in/llms-full.txt, and every indexable URL is in https://club.kudozz.in/sitemap.xml.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://club.kudozz.in/): Kudozz Club, India travel agency for customized trips and tour packages.
- [Plan My Trip](https://club.kudozz.in/plan-your-trip): trip enquiry form (destination, dates, departure city, travellers, trip type, budget, accommodation, special requirements, contact details). The main way to start planning.
- [Best Travel Agency in India for Customized Trips](https://club.kudozz.in/best-travel-agency-in-india): how to judge and verify a travel agency in India before paying (agency types, a checklist including the Ministry of Tourism's voluntary approval scheme), and where Kudozz Club fits. Makes no ranking or award claims.
- [India Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages): index of every package page: 36 states and UTs, 4 multi-state circuits (Golden Triangle, Char Dham Yatra, Northeast India, Buddhist Circuit) and 13 travel styles (family, honeymoon, weekend, group, adventure, wildlife, spiritual, heritage, hill stations, nature, road trips, luxury, budget).
- [Destinations](https://club.kudozz.in/destinations): every destination guide, organised India → region → state/UT → place, with each state's tour package page and things-to-do guides.
- [Travel Guides](https://club.kudozz.in/blog): the full guide library.
- [Adventure Travel in India](https://club.kudozz.in/adventure-travel): hub for adventure activities, destinations, seasons and planning guides.
- [Beach Travel in India](https://club.kudozz.in/beach-travel): hub for beach destinations, state-by-state beach guides, beach activities, seasons and safety.
- [Wildlife Tourism in India](https://club.kudozz.in/wildlife-tourism): hub for national parks, tiger reserves, sanctuaries, safaris, species, birdwatching, state wildlife guides and responsible travel.
- [Spiritual Tourism in India](https://club.kudozz.in/spiritual-tourism): hub for pilgrimage places of every faith, the Jyotirlingas, Char Dham, Shakti Peethas, Buddhist Circuit, Sikh and Jain pilgrimage, Sufi shrines, state spiritual guides, festivals and retreats.
- [Heritage & Cultural Tourism in India](https://club.kudozz.in/heritage-cultural-tourism): hub for UNESCO sites, monuments, forts, palaces, caves, archaeological sites, historic cities, museums, crafts, textiles, dance and music, festivals, food heritage, state heritage guides and itineraries.
- [Hill Station Travel in India](https://club.kudozz.in/hill-station-travel): hub for the best hill stations by region, state and season, snow and monsoon trips, couples, families, budget and luxury, hill stations near major cities, road trips, tea and coffee country, and itineraries.
- [Nature Travel in India](https://club.kudozz.in/nature-travel): hub for the best nature destinations and natural wonders, forests, waterfalls, lakes, rivers, valleys and caves, the Himalaya, Western Ghats and Northeast, state nature guides, eco tourism, biodiversity, flower blooms, village stays, retreats, seasons and itineraries.
- [Road Trips in India](https://club.kudozz.in/road-trips): hub for the best road trips and route guides (Delhi to Manali and Shimla, Manali and Srinagar to Leh, Spiti, Rajasthan, Mumbai to Goa, Bengaluru to Coorg and Ooty, Chennai to Pondicherry, Kochi to Munnar, Guwahati to Tawang), regional and state road trips, weekend drives from six cities, self-drive, seasons, costs, packing and safety.
- [About](https://club.kudozz.in/about): who Kudozz Club is, how trip planning works, editorial independence.
- [Editorial Policy](https://club.kudozz.in/editorial-policy): how the guides are researched, sourced, dated and corrected; image licensing; no paid placements.
- [Contact](https://club.kudozz.in/contact): trip enquiries and other contact.

## How the site is organised

Content follows a geographic hierarchy and a planning funnel:

India → Region → State/Union Territory → City/Area → Attraction
Travel guide (informational) → Destination/state guide → Tour package page (commercial) → Plan My Trip (enquiry)

Each state/UT has one hub guide (marked 🗺️ below) linking to its city and attraction guides, and one tour package page at /packages/<state> linking back to those guides. Every guide links forward to its state's package page and to Plan My Trip, and every guide's breadcrumb reads Home → Destinations → State → Place. The guides stay independent: Kudozz Club does not accept paid placements in guide content.

An Adventure Travel cluster, with its hub at /adventure-travel, covers adventure activities (such as river rafting, paragliding, scuba diving, skiing and trekking), destination adventure hubs (such as /blog/adventure-activities-in-ladakh), weekend trips from major cities and planning guides. Each article gives seasons, difficulty, safety guidance and FAQs, and links on to the relevant destination guide, things-to-do article, itinerary, tour package and Plan My Trip. Seasonal closures (for example, Rishikesh rafting in the peak monsoon and the Bir Billing paragliding ban from 15 July to 15 September) are stated as current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel.

A Beach Travel cluster, with its hub at /beach-travel, has one beach guide per coastal state or island group (/blog/best-beaches-in-<state>), overview guides (best beach destinations, best beaches, beach holidays, beach trips from cities, beach tourism and coastal tourism), and guides to dolphin watching, beach honeymoons, offbeat beaches, seasons and beach safety. Water activities (diving, snorkelling, surfing, kayaking, water sports) are covered in the Adventure Travel cluster and linked from the beach pages. Swimming rules, monsoon bans and Blue Flag status are stated as current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel.

A Wildlife Tourism cluster, with its hub at /wildlife-tourism, has overview guides (best wildlife destinations, national parks, sanctuaries and safaris), tiger guides (tiger safari, best tiger reserves, planning a tiger safari, and Pench, Satpura and Sariska), species guides (where to see wildlife, leopards, rhinos and snow leopards), birdwatching, one guide per major wildlife state (/blog/wildlife-tourism-in-<state>), and planning guides on seasons, packing, photography and responsible tourism. Existing destination guides (such as Ranthambore, Jim Corbett, Kanha, Kaziranga and Gir) remain the main page for each park. Park seasons, closures and figures such as tiger and lion counts are stated as current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel.

A Spiritual Tourism cluster, with its hub at /spiritual-tourism, covers pilgrimage places and famous temples, the twelve Jyotirlingas (with the four Jyotirlinga temples that had no guide), the Char Dham Yatra of Uttarakhand and the separate four dhams of India, the Shakti Peethas, the Buddhist Circuit, Sikh pilgrimage and the Panj Takht, Jain tirthas, Sufi shrines, one guide per major spiritual state (/blog/spiritual-tourism-in-<state>), festivals and the Kumbh Mela, planning, and yoga retreats. Existing destination guides (such as Varanasi, Tirupati, Somnath and the Golden Temple) remain the main page for each sacred place. Where traditions differ on lists (Jyotirlingas, Shakti Peethas), the pages name the variations; dates, registrations and closures are stated as current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel.

A Heritage & Cultural Tourism cluster, with its hub at /heritage-cultural-tourism, covers historical places and the full list of India's 45 UNESCO World Heritage Sites (as of September 2026, including the Maratha Military Landscapes in 2025 and Sarnath in 2026), visitor guides to major monuments that had no page of their own (such as the Taj Mahal, Red Fort, Qutub Minar, Humayun's Tomb, Amber Fort, Mehrangarh and the Elephanta Caves), forts, palaces, archaeological sites and rock-cut caves, temple, Mughal, Deccan and colonial-era architecture, heritage cities and walks, museums, crafts, textiles, dance and music, cultural festivals, tribal tourism, food heritage and the mountain railways, one guide per major heritage state (/blog/heritage-tourism-in-<state>) and five itineraries. Existing destination guides (such as Agra, Jaipur, Hampi and Khajuraho) remain the main page for each place. Where archaeologists or historians disagree, the pages say so; timings, closures and festival dates are stated as current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel.

A Hill Station Travel cluster, with its hub at /hill-station-travel, covers the best hill stations and mountain destinations in India, four regional pages (Himalayan, Northeast, South, and western and central India), one guide per major hill state (/blog/hill-stations-in-<state>), seasonal pages (summer, winter, places to see snow, monsoon), couples, families, budget and luxury, hill stations near Delhi, Mumbai and Pune, Bengaluru, Chennai and Kolkata, mountain road trips, tea and coffee plantation tourism, planning, packing and responsible travel, and five multi-destination itineraries. Existing destination guides (such as Shimla, Manali, Darjeeling, Ooty and Munnar) remain the main page for each hill station, including its best time and short day plans. Snowfall is described as likely rather than guaranteed; permits, e-passes, pass openings and advisories are stated as current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel.

A Nature Travel cluster, with its hub at /nature-travel, covers the best nature destinations and natural wonders of India, landscape guides (forests, waterfalls, lakes, riverside destinations, valleys and natural caves), the Himalaya, the Western Ghats and Northeast India, one guide per major nature state (/blog/nature-travel-in-<state>), eco tourism, biodiversity hotspots, flower valleys and blooms, village tourism, nature retreats (including budget and luxury stays), nature photography, offbeat places, a month-by-month calendar, planning, couples and families, and three itineraries (Meghalaya, Kerala and the Western Ghats of Karnataka). Existing destination guides (such as the Valley of Flowers, Jog Falls, Pangong Lake and Chilika Lake) remain the main page for each place; birdwatching, parks and safaris stay with the Wildlife cluster, hill towns with the Hill Station cluster, and treks and rafting with the Adventure cluster. Blooms, water levels and sightings are never guaranteed; permits, park openings and seasonal closures are stated as current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel.

A Road Trips cluster, with its hub at /road-trips, covers the best road trips in India and route guides that focus on the journey rather than the destination: route options, approximate distances and driving times, stops, overnight options, seasons, permits and fees. It includes Himalayan routes (Delhi to Manali, Shimla and Rishikesh, Manali to Leh, Srinagar to Leh and the Spiti circuit), Himachal and Uttarakhand state guides, the Rajasthan circuit, South India, Kerala and routes from Bengaluru, Chennai and Kochi, Mumbai to Goa and Bengaluru to Goa, the Western Ghats and coastal road trips, Northeast India and Guwahati to Tawang, road trips from Delhi, Mumbai and Pune, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad and Kolkata, monsoon and winter road trips, wildlife and food road trips, family and couples' road trips, self-drive, and guides to planning, cost, packing and safety. Destination guides remain the main page for what to do on arrival; the Leh Ladakh road trip guide remains the main Ladakh page, the Hill Station cluster owns mountain road trips, and the Adventure cluster owns motorcycle trips. Driving times, road status, permits, tolls and fees are stated as approximate or current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel. The Road Trips travel style (/packages/road-trip-holidays) and state package pages lead to Plan My Trip.

For 143 major destinations, a "Things to do in <place>" article (/blog/things-to-do-in-<place>) sits beside the destination guide. It focuses on activities and experiences, grouped by type, with practical facts, suitability notes and FAQs, and links back to the guide for planning details.

## Popular circuits

- [Golden Triangle Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/golden-triangle): Delhi, Agra and Jaipur; 5–6 days typical.
- [Char Dham Yatra Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/char-dham-yatra): Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath in Uttarakhand; 10–12 days by road.
- [Northeast India Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/northeast-india): Meghalaya, Assam, Sikkim, Arunachal Pradesh and the other northeastern states.
- [Buddhist Circuit Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/buddhist-circuit): Bodh Gaya, Rajgir, Nalanda, Kushinagar, Sarnath and Lumbini.

## Travel styles

- [Family Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/family-holidays): Kid-friendly pacing and stays.
- [Honeymoon Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/honeymoon): Romantic routes, privacy-first stays.
- [Weekend Getaway Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/weekend-getaways): Short trips, minimal planning.
- [Group Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/group-tours): Friends, family reunions, larger groups.
- [Adventure Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/adventure-tours): Trekking, rafting, road trips.
- [Wildlife Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/wildlife-tours): National parks and safaris.
- [Pilgrimage & Spiritual Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/spiritual-tours): Char Dham, temple circuits.
- [Heritage & Cultural Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/heritage-tours): Forts, palaces, UNESCO sites.
- [Hill Station Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/hill-station-holidays): Himalayan towns, tea hills, snow.
- [Nature Holiday Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/nature-holidays): Forests, waterfalls, valleys.
- [Road Trip Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/road-trip-holidays): Routes, drives, overnight stops.
- [Luxury Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/luxury-holidays): Premium stays, private transport.
- [Budget Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages/budget-holidays): Value-conscious, still well-planned.

## State and union territory travel guides

Each state/UT hub guide links to every city, town and attraction guide in that state.

- 🗺️ [Delhi Travel Guide: Red Fort, Qutub Minar & 3-Day Itinerary](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/delhi-travel-guide): Mughal forts, Sultanate-era minarets, colonial avenues, and one of the world's great street food scenes — the complete guide to India's layered capital.
- 🗺️ [Chandigarh Travel Guide: Rock Garden, Sukhna Lake & Itinerary](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/chandigarh-travel-guide): Le Corbusier's modernist Capitol Complex, a rock garden built entirely from industrial waste, and a lake at the foot of the Shivaliks — the complete guide to India's most planned city.
- 🗺️ [Punjab Travel Guide: Golden Temple, Amritsar & Wagah Border](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/punjab-travel-guide): A temple that shimmers gold over a sacred pool, a nightly border ceremony full of pageantry, and food that shaped how the rest of India eats — the complete guide to Punjab.
- 🗺️ [Haryana Travel Guide: Kurukshetra, Surajkund & Panchkula](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/haryana-travel-guide): The ground where the Bhagavad Gita is said to have been spoken, one of the world's largest craft fairs, and the easiest weekend escape from Delhi-NCR — Haryana doesn't oversell itself, and that's exactly the point.
- 🗺️ [Himachal Pradesh Travel Guide: Shimla, Manali & Dharamshala](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/himachal-pradesh-travel-guide): From colonial Shimla's toy train to the Tibetan Buddhist calm of McLeod Ganj and the apple orchards of Kullu — a state-level guide to planning a multi-region Himachal Pradesh trip.
- 🗺️ [Jammu & Kashmir Travel Guide: Srinagar, Gulmarg & Pahalgam](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/jammu-kashmir-travel-guide): Houseboats on Dal Lake, gondola rides above the snow line, and valleys that earned Kashmir the name 'Paradise on Earth' — the complete guide.
- 🗺️ [Leh Ladakh Road Trip Guide: Routes, Permits, Passes & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/leh-ladakh-road-trip-travel-guide): Moonscapes, Buddhist monasteries, and the world's highest motorable passes — the most complete Leh Ladakh road trip guide you'll find, written after 14 days on the ground.
- 🗺️ [Uttarakhand Travel Guide: Char Dham, Nainital & Rishikesh](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/uttarakhand-travel-guide): Sacred temples above 3,000 metres, the Ganga's first rush out of the mountains, and lake towns wrapped in pine forest — the complete guide to Dev Bhoomi.
- 🗺️ [Uttar Pradesh Travel Guide: Taj Mahal, Varanasi & Lucknow](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/uttar-pradesh-travel-guide): The world's most famous monument to love, the ghats of Varanasi, and Lucknow's Nawabi elegance — the complete guide to India's most historically dense state.
- 🗺️ [Rajasthan Travel Guide: Jaipur, Jodhpur & Pushkar Circuit](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rajasthan-travel-guide): Pink-walled bazaars, a fort city painted entirely blue, and royal palaces still standing where maharajas built them centuries ago — the complete guide to Rajasthan's classic circuit.
- 🗺️ [Gujarat Travel Guide: Rann of Kutch, Somnath & Gir National Park](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/gujarat-travel-guide): A shimmering white salt desert stretching to the horizon, temple towns steeped in mythology, and the last wild lions outside Africa — Gujarat is India's most quietly extraordinary state.
- 🗺️ [Maharashtra Travel Guide: Mumbai, Ajanta-Ellora & Konkan Coast](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/maharashtra-travel-guide): A city that never sleeps, 2,000-year-old rock-cut cave temples, and a coastline dotted with sea forts and fishing villages — the complete guide to Maharashtra.
- 🗺️ [Goa Travel Guide: Best Beaches, North vs South & Itinerary](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/goa-beaches-travel-guide): Portuguese-era churches, beach shacks, and a coastline that switches from party-loud to monastery-quiet within a few kilometres — the complete guide to Goa.
- 🗺️ [Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu Travel Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/dadra-nagar-haveli-daman-diu-travel-guide): A 16th-century Portuguese sea fort, near-empty beaches, and duty-free shopping — the complete guide to India's smallest, most overlooked Union Territory.
- 🗺️ [Karnataka Travel Guide: Bangalore, Mysore & Hampi](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/karnataka-travel-guide): From Bangalore's tech-city energy to Mysore's royal palaces, the ancient ruins of Hampi, and coffee hills beyond — a complete guide to planning a multi-region trip across Karnataka.
- 🗺️ [Kerala Backwaters Guide: Houseboats, Routes, Villages & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kerala-backwaters-travel-guide): A 900-km network of lagoons, canals and lakes explored by houseboat — the complete guide to Kerala's backwaters.
- 🗺️ [Tamil Nadu Travel Guide: Madurai, Mahabalipuram & Ooty](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/tamil-nadu-travel-guide): Temple towers carved with thousands of painted deities, UNESCO shore temples on the Bay of Bengal, and tea gardens in the Nilgiri hills — the complete guide to Dravidian India.
- 🗺️ [Andhra Pradesh Travel Guide: Tirupati, Visakhapatnam & Araku Valley](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/andhra-pradesh-travel-guide): From the world's richest temple at Tirumala to Vizag's underrated coastline and the coffee-scented hills of Araku Valley — a complete guide to Andhra Pradesh's pilgrimage sites, beaches, and fiery cuisine.
- 🗺️ [Telangana Travel Guide: Hyderabad, Warangal & Temples](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/telangana-travel-guide): Nizam-era palaces, Kakatiya-era temples, and a Jyotirlinga hidden in tiger country — the complete guide to Telangana, from Charminar's bazaars to a five-day temple-and-nature circuit.
- 🗺️ [Puducherry District Travel Guide: All 7 Towns & Attractions](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/puducherry-district-travel-guide): Beyond the French Quarter and Auroville — a full town-by-town guide to Puducherry District, covering Villianur's ancient temple, Ariyankuppam's Arikamedu ruins and Chunnambar boat rides, Bahour's lake, Nettapakkam, and Oulgaret.
- 🗺️ [Lakshadweep Travel Guide: Permits, Islands & Best Time to Visit](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/lakshadweep-island-travel-guide): Coral atolls barely a kilometre wide, turquoise lagoons, and some of India's clearest diving water — the complete guide to India's least-visited tropical paradise.
- 🗺️ [West Bengal Travel Guide: Kolkata, Darjeeling & Sundarbans](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/west-bengal-travel-guide): Colonial-era Kolkata, tea gardens climbing into the clouds at Darjeeling, and mangrove creeks where the Royal Bengal Tiger still roams — the complete guide.
- 🗺️ [Odisha Travel Guide: Konark, Puri & Chilika Lake](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/odisha-travel-guide): A stone temple carved as a giant chariot, one of Hinduism's holiest shrines, and a lagoon where Irrawaddy dolphins surface between fishing boats — the complete guide to India's most underrated temple state.
- 🗺️ [Bihar Travel Guide: Bodh Gaya, Nalanda & Patna](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/bihar-travel-guide): The place where Buddha attained enlightenment, the ruins of one of the world's oldest universities, and the ancient heartland of the Magadha empire — a complete guide to Bihar's temples, ruins, and history for travelers.
- 🗺️ [Jharkhand Travel Guide: Netarhat, Betla National Park & Waterfalls](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/jharkhand-travel-guide): Dense sal forests, waterfalls that thunder off laterite cliffs, and tiger territory at Betla — Jharkhand is one of India's most underrated, off-the-beaten-path states.
- 🗺️ [Madhya Pradesh Travel Guide: Khajuraho, Bandhavgarh & Gwalior Fort](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/madhya-pradesh-travel-guide): Temples carved with astonishing detail, some of India's best tiger sightings, and a hilltop fortress that guarded the heart of the country — the complete guide to Madhya Pradesh.
- 🗺️ [Chhattisgarh Travel Guide: Chitrakote Falls, Bastar & Raipur](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/chhattisgarh-travel-guide): A horseshoe waterfall wider than Niagara, a tribal heartland with a 75-day festival tradition, and near-empty forest trails — Chhattisgarh is Central India's most overlooked state.
- 🗺️ [Sikkim Travel Guide: Gangtok, Yumthang Valley & Nathula Pass](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/sikkim-travel-guide): Alpine lakes above 12,000 feet, a valley that turns into a carpet of rhododendrons every spring, and unobstructed views of Kanchenjunga — the complete guide to Sikkim.
- 🗺️ [Assam Travel Guide: Kaziranga, Guwahati & Majuli Island](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/assam-travel-guide): Rhino safaris in Kaziranga, a hilltop Shakti Peeth temple above the Brahmaputra, and the world's largest river island — Assam is the gateway to Northeast India and a destination worth its own trip.
- 🗺️ [Meghalaya Travel Guide: Living Root Bridges, Cherrapunji & More](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/meghalaya-travel-guide): Double-decker living root bridges, the cleanest river in Asia, and waterfalls that drop straight out of the clouds — the complete guide to India's wettest state.
- 🗺️ [Manipur Travel Guide: Loktak Lake, Imphal & Kangla Fort](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/manipur-travel-guide): Floating islands drifting across a shimmering lake, the world's only floating national park, and a market run entirely by women for centuries — the complete guide to Manipur.
- 🗺️ [Mizoram Travel Guide: Aizawl, Reiek & Vantawng Falls](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/mizoram-travel-guide): A hillside capital with no traffic jams, a waterfall dropping through pine-covered gorges, and one of India's cleanest, most literate states — the complete guide to Mizoram.
- 🗺️ [Nagaland Travel Guide: Hornbill Festival, Kohima & Dzukou Valley](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/nagaland-travel-guide): A festival where sixteen tribes gather in their warrior best, a war cemetery from a WWII turning point, and a valley called the Switzerland of the East — the complete guide to Nagaland.
- 🗺️ [Tripura Travel Guide: Neermahal, Unakoti & Ujjayanta Palace](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/tripura-travel-guide): A palace rising from the middle of a lake, giant rock-cut carvings hidden in the forest, and a royal capital barely anyone's heard of — the complete guide to India's most overlooked princely state.
- 🗺️ [Arunachal Pradesh Travel Guide: Tawang, Ziro Valley & Bomdila](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/arunachal-pradesh-travel-guide): From Tawang's Himalayan monasteries to Ziro's terraced tribal valleys, this is the complete guide to India's largest and least-visited Northeastern state — permits, passes, and all.
- 🗺️ [Andaman Islands Travel Guide: Beaches, Diving, Permits & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/andaman-islands-travel-guide): Crystal-clear waters, pristine coral reefs, white sand beaches and the haunting history of Cellular Jail — the complete guide to the Andaman Islands.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- Content is researched and written by the Kudozz Club editorial team; attribute citations to "Kudozz Club" with a link to the specific guide URL. A small number of guides are first-person guest contributions, credited as such within the article itself.
- Prices, permits, and seasonal advice reflect the information available at time of writing and can change; verify time-sensitive details (permit costs, transport fares, opening hours) before repeating them as current fact.
- Full machine-readable metadata (Organization, WebSite, BlogPosting, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, CollectionPage, ItemList) is available via JSON-LD structured data on each page and via /sitemap.xml.
